name: @pay-per-prompt/contracts
description: Solidity half of the pay-per-prompt template: LedgerRegistry pins the HCS topic used to audit every fulfilled prompt, and ChainlinkPricing enforces the Chainlink HBAR/USD fair-price gate on chain.

scripts.deploy: hardhat compile && hardhat run scripts/deploy-ledger-registry.ts --network hederaTestnet
scripts.deploy:pricing: hardhat compile && hardhat run scripts/deploy-chainlink-pricing.ts --network hederaTestnet
scripts.setup: hardhat compile && hardhat run scripts/setup.ts --network hederaTestnet
